AMD R290 vapor-x; will it play?

Most likely yes. AMD drivers are not very good even on windows. On Linux they are even worse. When I switch to the fglrx driver on Linux some of my games will not even start(Like Battle Block Theater, and Strike Suit Zero). Games that do run will run worse than on a comparable Nvidia card due to the poor opengl performance of the AMD driver. I also have an issue where my HDMI Audio crackles forcing me to use analogue audio. The latest fglrx driver released in June supposedly fixes the performance issues, but I have not been able to try it since it doesn't even support kernel 3.19 which was released back in February yet the previous fglrx driver does...

When I switch to the open source driver I see a large performance decrease compared to the fglrx driver.

If you're asking because you want to purchase a R290 then don't. Get an Nvidia card instead.
